android.desc:
Love the idea of journaling, but struggle with a blank page? Just talk.

AudioDiary is an audio diary and voice journal for getting thoughts out of your head and into words. Talk through your day, capture a memory or untangle something on your mind. Automatic transcription turns your recordings into readable, searchable entries.

No perfect sentences. No pressure to write. Just a little time for yourself.

A JOURNAL THAT HELPS YOU REFLECT

Go beyond recording with optional AI feedback that helps you reflect on what you’ve shared. Personalised follow-up questions give you somewhere to start next time, while monthly summaries help you look back on the bigger picture.

WANT TO TALK IT THROUGH?

Dive deeper into today’s entry with a back-and-forth AI conversation. Explore what’s on your mind with thoughtful questions and spoken replies, drawing on relevant things you’ve shared in past entries.

Choose an personality that suits you, from a warm friend to a practical life coach, and pick a voice you enjoy listening to.

KEEP YOUR WORDS, IN YOUR VOICE

Listen back to your recordings or read their transcripts. Edit the wording, add photos and find past entries with search and tags. Keep everyday moments and important memories together.

NOTICE HOW YOU FEEL

Use the mood tracker to see how you feel over time. Revisit your entries to explore your highs and lows, and get weekly mood insights when you’ve recorded enough moods.

TURN INTENTIONS INTO GOALS

Capture goals as you talk, review suggested next steps and track your progress. Connect Google Calendar to give your plans a place in your day.

MORE WAYS TO JOURNAL

Keep a dream journal, explore an idea or take a moment for gratitude. Journaling prompts help when you want to reflect but aren’t sure where to begin. Android home-screen widgets let you quickly start a diary entry, idea or dream recording.

MAKE IT YOURS

Use Session Designer to choose what’s included in your sessions. Set reminders to suit your routine, add your own prompts and personalise your diary with themes.

YOUR DIARY, UNDER YOUR CONTROL

Add a PIN lock, manage the memories used to personalise your AI feedback, and delete entries or your account in the app. AI reflections are optional: turn off analysis whenever you like and keep recording and transcribing your thoughts.

quotes.text:
I'm working on AudioDiary which is next-gen journalling app https://audiodiary.ai

Recently it got a surge of users (1k+ reviews on Google Play and 500+ reviews on Apple, really sucks that Apple don't show all reviews, but you can check the Google reviews here on desktop https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=me.audiodiary.audiodiary) and people are writing in every day to say how much they love it and that it's changing their lives.

Also working on a new app in a similar vein that's way more technically complex and uses AI in a hands-on way, and looking for help on it.
